acceptance.run.description: run the specification's conformance suite against the release

release.build.description: build a release revision from the merged changes

release.publish.description: publish and deploy the current release revision; needs a person's approval

release.rollback.description: return to the previous release; needs the same release authority

spec.gate.description: run the ESS gate over the current specification revision

spec.description: the ESS specification; its revision is its spec digest, as in the parent case

gate.passed.description: the ESS gate passes on the current specification revision

release.accepted.description: the conformance suite of the current specification passes on the current release

release.built.description: the current release revision carries build provenance

release.healthy.description: the published release is observed healthy within the last 30 minutes

release.published.description: the current release revision is published

rollback.complete.description: a rollback of the current release revision is complete

build_provenance.description: the record of how a release revision was built from the merged changes

ess_gate.description: the ESS gate over a specification revision, the four checks run as one program; passed or failed

health_observation.description: an observation of the running release; its result is healthy or unhealthy, and it applies for 30 minutes after it is observed

release_conformance.description: `ess verify conform run --target <release> --strict` of the specification's suite against a release revision; its result is passed, failed or inconclusive

release_record.description: the record that a release revision was published

rollback_result.description: the result of returning to the release before this one; complete or partial

spec.revised.description: a conformance run observed against an earlier specification revision no longer applies

acceptance.required.description: the conformance suite passes on the release

gate.required.description: the ESS gate passes on the current specification revision

passed.description: the ESS gate passes, and the current release is built, accepted, published and observed healthy

rolled_back.description: the release was rolled back completely

protocol.description: Release and operate the result of a specification whose stories are delivered: build a release with provenance, run the ESS conformance suite of the current specification revision against it, publish it on a person's approval, and observe it running. The ESS gate must pass on the current specification revision. A revised specification invalidates the conformance runs observed against the earlier revision. The case ends passed (operating), rolled back on a complete rollback result, or withheld on an explicit decision.
